text: This is where the individual talent becomes a team problem. Imagine you are the full-back facing Lamine. Your midfielder comes across to help. That can be the right decision, but now there is less protection inside. A Barcelona runner moves into that space, and the centre-back has a choice: step out, or hold the line. Neither choice is automatically wrong. The danger is choosing late, or choosing something different from the defender beside you. That is the tactical interpretation behind these combinations. Barcelona keep giving the opposition decisions to make, then try to attack the moment between one decision and the next. It does not mean every possession is perfect. It means a defensive plan has to work repeatedly, against different players, for the whole match. And just when tired legs start making those decisions harder, Flick has more options to introduce.
